run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if a binary string decimal value is divisible by 10
test_f_gold: test f_gold with binary strings like '101000' and '1000' to verify divisibility logic
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes decimal divisibility by 10 using positional digit accumulation
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python int conversion instead of manual positional sum calculation
review_f_gold: review f_gold binary string divisibility check and its test harness in the main block
